title: Hubiese in Writing
goal: Recognise hubiese + participle, the -se form, as the same thing as hubiera + participle in books and formal writing.

items: I can recognise hubiese + participle as the same as hubiera + participle.
I can read hubiese in older and more formal writing.
I can use the new words for books and editions.
